name: atkx
description: AI Team Kit extras - utility skills that depend on no artifact and on no delivery lifecycle, and may call atk skills. Two skills: skill-eval, which evaluates a skill a project has written: a static check with a security gate, the project's own conventions, trigger measurement on Claude Code, drafted trigger cases, a review of one run, and a composite score; and doc-audit, which checks a written document claim by claim against the code, a requirement source or another document, one verdict per claim with its evidence, and changes no document. It needs atk, so install atk as well.
